description: Create a project. The code must be unique in the workspace, and there is no update endpoint afterwards — title, code and access cannot be changed through the API, so choose them deliberately. Read an existing project with qase_project_context. Cost: one API call, about 1.5s.

access.description: Who can access the project: everyone, a team group, or nobody but the owner

code.description: Project code — unique per workspace, 2 to 10 characters of uppercase letters, digits or underscores

group.description: Team group hash — required when access is "group"

name: qase_project_create
title: Create project
